title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Effect on Model Variance
text: Consider how reducing the number of features (by setting some coefficients to zero) might affect the model's variance.
